recipes.name: Doro Wat
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs chicken thighs, skin removed
• 1/2 cup berbere spice
• 1 large onion, finely diced
• 3 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 2 cups water
• 4 hard-boiled eggs
• 1 tbsp garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger, minced
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dry sauté onions until browned (15 min).
2. Add niter kibbeh, then berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 5 min.
3. Add chicken, coat well. Cook 10 minutes.
4. Add water, bring to boil, simmer 45 min until tender.
5. Add scored hard-boiled eggs, simmer 10 more min.
6. Season with salt. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 1 hr 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Misir Wat
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups red lentils, rinsed
• 1 large onion, diced
• 1/4 cup berbere spice
• 3 tbsp niter kibbeh or oil
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger, grated
• 4 cups water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions until browned.
2. Add oil, berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 3 min.
3. Add lentils, stir to coat.
4. Add water, bring to boil.
5. Cover, simmer 30-40 min until lentils are soft and stew thickens.
6. Season with salt. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 45 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Kitfo
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb lean beef, finely minced
• 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 2 tbsp mitmita spice
• 1 tsp cardamom powder
• Salt to taste
• Ayib (cottage cheese) for serving

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Remove all fat from beef and mince very fine.
2. Heat niter kibbeh until hot. Pour over beef, mix well.
3. Add mitmita, cardamom, salt. Mix thoroughly.
4. Serve raw with injera and ayib.
5. For leb-leb (lightly cooked), briefly cook in hot butter 1-2 min.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 2-3

recipes.name: Tibs
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb beef sirloin, cubed
• 1 large onion, sliced
• 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 2 tbsp berbere
• 1 tbsp garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger, grated
• 1 green chili (optional)
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Season beef with salt and berbere.
2. Heat niter kibbeh over high heat.
3. Sear beef until browned (2-3 min).
4. Add onions, garlic, ginger. Cook 2 min.
5. Add berbere, toss well.
6. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 2-3

recipes.name: Shiro Wat
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups chickpea flour (shiro)
• 1 large onion, finely diced
• 1/4 cup berbere
• 1/2 cup oil
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger, grated
• 4 cups water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until golden.
2. Add berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 3 min.
3. Add water gradually, whisking.
4. Slowly add chickpea flour, whisking continuously.
5. Simmer 20 min, stirring often, until thick and smooth.
6. Season with salt. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Gomen
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb collard greens, finely chopped
• 1 large onion, diced
• 3 tbsp niter kibbeh or oil
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger, grated
• 1 green chili (optional)
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in niter kibbeh until translucent.
2. Add garlic, ginger, chili. Cook 2 min.
3. Add collard greens, stir well.
4. Cover and cook on low 20 min, stirring occasionally.
5. Season with salt. Serve as a side with injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Atkilt Wat
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1/2 head cabbage, chopped
• 2 carrots, sliced
• 2 potatoes, cubed
• 1 onion, sliced
• 3 tbsp oil
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp cumin
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until soft.
2. Add turmeric, cumin. Cook 1 min.
3. Add carrots and potatoes. Cook 5 min.
4. Add cabbage, stir well.
5. Cover, cook on low 20 min until tender.
6. Season with salt. Serve as a side.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Firfir
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 injera pieces, torn
• 1/2 cup berbere sauce
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 tbsp oil
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until golden.
2. Add berbere sauce and niter kibbeh. Cook 3 min.
3. Add torn injera, stir to coat.
4. Cook 2 min until injera softens.
5. Serve hot, traditionally for breakfast.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 2

recipes.name: Dulet
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb beef tripe
• 1/2 lb beef liver
• 1/2 lb lean beef
• 1 large onion, finely diced
• 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 2 tbsp mitmita
• 1 tsp cardamom
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Boil tripe until tender (1 hr). Finely mince all meats.
2. Sauté onions in niter kibbeh until soft.
3. Add minced meats. Cook 5 min, stirring.
4. Add mitmita, cardamom, salt. Mix well.
5. Cook 2 more min. Serve with injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 1 hr 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Kik Alicha
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups yellow split peas, rinsed
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 tbsp oil
• 1 tbsp garlic, minced
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• 4 cups water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until translucent.
2. Add garlic, ginger, turmeric. Cook 2 min.
3. Add split peas and water. Bring to boil.
4. Cover, simmer 40 min until soft.
5. Mash slightly, season with salt.
6. Serve as a mild side dish.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 45 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Azifa
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups green lentils
• 1 onion, finely diced
• 2 jalapenos, minced
• 1/4 cup lemon juice
• 3 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp mustard seeds
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Boil lentils 20 min until tender. Drain and cool.
2. Mix lentils with onion and jalapenos.
3. Whisk lemon juice, oil, mustard seeds, salt, pepper.
4. Pour dressing over lentils, toss.
5. Refrigerate 30 min. Serve cold.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Timatim Fitfit
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 ripe tomatoes, diced
• 1 onion, finely diced
• 2 pieces injera, torn
• 2 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 green chili, minced
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix tomatoes, onion, chili in a bowl.
2. Add lemon juice, olive oil, salt. Toss.
3. Add torn injera, mix gently.
4. Let sit 5 min. Serve as a refreshing salad.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 2-3

recipes.name: Buticha
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups cooked chickpeas, coarsely mashed
• 1 onion, finely diced
• 2 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 green chili, minced
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Coarsely mash chickpeas with a fork.
2. Mix in onion, chili, cumin, salt.
3. Add lemon juice and olive oil. Stir well.
4. Adjust seasoning. Serve chilled or at room temp.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Key Sir Alicha
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 medium beets, boiled and cubed
• 1 potato, boiled and cubed
• 1 onion, thinly sliced
• 2 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp salt
• Fresh parsley

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Boil beets and potato until tender. Cube.
2. Combine with sliced onion.
3. Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil. Season with salt.
4. Toss gently, garnish with parsley.
5. Serve chilled.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Ethiopian Salad
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 tomatoes, diced
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1 onion, thinly sliced
• 1 jalapeno, sliced
• 3 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Combine all vegetables in a bowl.
2. Whisk lemon juice, oil, salt, pepper.
3. Pour dressing over, toss.
4. Serve alongside spicy stews.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Silsi
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 6 ripe tomatoes, blended
• 1 onion, finely diced
• 3 tbsp berbere
• 3 tbsp oil
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until deep golden.
2. Add berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 3 min.
3. Add blended tomatoes, simmer 20 min until thick.
4. Season with salt. Use for firfir or dipping.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Chechebsa
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups all-purpose flour
• 1 cup water
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 2 tbsp berbere
• 1 onion, diced

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, water, salt into a thin batter.
2. Cook thin pancakes on a hot greased pan.
3. Stack and shred pancakes into strips.
4. Sauté onions in niter kibbeh with berbere.
5. Toss shredded pancakes in the sauce.
6. Serve hot with honey or yogurt.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Genfo
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups barley or wheat flour
• 4 cups water
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 3 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 2 tbsp berbere
• Honey or yogurt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Bring water and salt to a boil.
2. Gradually add flour, stirring vigorously.
3. Stir until thick and smooth (10 min).
4. Shape into a mound on a plate with a well.
5. Fill well with warm niter kibbeh and berbere.
6. Serve with honey or yogurt.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Kita
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups all-purpose flour
• 1 cup water
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 2 tbsp oil
• 1 tsp cumin seeds (optional)

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, salt, cumin. Add water to form dough.
2. Knead 5 min. Rest 15 min.
3. Divide into balls, flatten into rounds.
4. Cook in oiled pan until golden on both sides.
5. Serve warm with honey, butter, or stew.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Ambasha
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 cups all-purpose flour
• 1 cup warm water
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 2 tbsp butter
• 1 tsp yeast
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 1 tsp cardamom

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Sit 5 min.
2. Mix flour, salt, cardamom. Add yeast mixture and butter.
3. Knead into dough. Let rise 1 hr.
4. Shape into round loaf, score cross on top.
5. Bake at 350°F 25-30 min until golden.
6. Brush with butter. Serve warm.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 6-8

recipes.name: Himbasha
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 cups flour
• 1 cup warm milk
• 1/4 cup sugar
• 1/4 cup butter, melted
• 2 tsp yeast
• 1 tsp cardamom
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 1 tsp black sesame seeds

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm milk. Sit 5 min.
2. Mix flour, cardamom, salt. Add milk mixture and butter.
3. Knead 10 min. Let rise 1 hr.
4. Shape into round loaf. Decorate with patterns.
5. Brush with butter, sprinkle sesame seeds.
6. Bake at 350°F 30 min. Traditional celebration bread.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr 15 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 8

recipes.name: Dabo Kolo
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups all-purpose flour
• 1/2 cup water
• 2 tbsp berbere
• 1/4 cup oil
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tsp sugar

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, berbere, salt, sugar.
2. Add oil and water to form stiff dough.
3. Knead 5 min. Roll into long ropes.
4. Cut into small bite-sized pieces.
5. Deep fry at 350°F until golden and crispy.
6. Drain on paper towels. Cool before storing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Kolo
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups barley grains
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 1 tsp berbere (optional)

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Rinse and soak barley 30 min. Drain.
2. Dry roast in pan on medium heat, stirring.
3. Roast until golden and crackling (15 min).
4. Drizzle with niter kibbeh and berbere. Toss.
5. Cool and serve as a crunchy snack.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 35 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Berbere
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 10 dried chilies, seeded
• 2 tbsp cumin seeds
• 1 tbsp coriander seeds
• 1 tsp fenugreek seeds
• 1 tsp black peppercorns
• 1 tsp cardamom seeds
• 4 cloves
• 1 tsp ginger powder
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Toast all dry spices 2-3 min until fragrant.
2. Cool completely. Grind into fine powder.
3. Mix in ginger powder, garlic powder, salt.
4. Store airtight. Base spice for Ethiopian dishes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 5 min | 🍴 Yield: 1 cup

recipes.name: Niter Kibbeh
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb unsalted butter
• 1 onion, sliced
• 3 cloves garlic
• 1 tbsp ginger, sliced
• 1 tsp cumin seeds
• 1 tsp cardamom seeds
• 1 tsp fenugreek seeds
• 1 cinnamon stick
• 2 cloves

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Melt butter on low heat.
2. Add all ingredients. Simmer 30 min (don't boil).
3. Skim off milk solids that rise.
4. Strain through cheesecloth into a jar.
5. Refrigerate up to 3 months.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Yield: ~1.5 cups

recipes.name: Awaze
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1/2 cup berbere
• 1/2 cup red wine or water
• 2 tbsp oil
• 1 tbsp garlic, minced
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix berbere with wine to form a paste.
2. Heat oil. Sauté garlic and ginger.
3. Add berbere paste. Cook 5 min on low.
4. Season with salt. Cool.
5. Use as dipping sauce for kitfo or tibs.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 5 min | 🍴 Yield: 1 cup

recipes.name: Key Wot
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lb beef chuck, cubed
• 1 cup berbere
• 2 large onions, finely diced
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 4 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 cups beef broth
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dry sauté onions until deeply browned (20 min).
2. Add niter kibbeh, berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 5 min.
3. Add beef, brown on all sides.
4. Add broth, bring to boil. Reduce heat.
5. Cover, simmer 1.5 hrs until beef is tender.
6. Season with salt. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 2 hrs | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Ye'beg Wot
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lb lamb shoulder, cubed
• 3/4 cup berbere
• 2 onions, finely diced
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 4 cloves garlic
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 cups water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dry sauté onions until caramelized (15 min).
2. Add niter kibbeh, berbere. Cook 5 min.
3. Add lamb, brown on all sides.
4. Add garlic, ginger, water. Bring to boil.
5. Cover, simmer 1.5-2 hrs until lamb is tender.
6. Season with salt. Serve with injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 2 hrs | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Asa Wot
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lb tilapia fillets
• 1/2 cup berbere
• 1 onion, diced
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tomatoes, blended
• 1 cup water
• Lemon juice, salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate fish in lemon juice and salt 15 min.
2. Sauté onions in niter kibbeh until golden.
3. Add berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 3 min.
4. Add tomatoes and water. Simmer 10 min.
5. Gently add fish. Cover, cook 15 min on low.
6. Serve with injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Dorho Wot
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 whole chicken, cut up
• 1 cup berbere
• 2 onions, finely diced
• 1/2 cup niter kibbeh
• 4 cloves garlic
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 1 tsp cardamom
• 4 hard-boiled eggs
• 2 cups water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Caramelize onions dry (20 min).
2. Add niter kibbeh, berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 5 min.
3. Add chicken, brown 10 min.
4. Add water, cardamom. Boil, then simmer 45 min.
5. Add eggs. Simmer 10 more min.
6. Season with salt. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 1 hr 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Sega Wot
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lb beef brisket, cubed
• 1 cup berbere
• 2 onions, diced
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 4 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 cups beef broth
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Caramelize onions dry until dark (20 min).
2. Add niter kibbeh, berbere, garlic, ginger. Stir 5 min.
3. Add beef, brown all sides.
4. Add broth. Simmer 2 hrs on low until fork-tender.
5. Season with salt. Serve with injera or rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 2 hrs 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Zilzil Tibs
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb beef sirloin, thin strips
• 2 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 2 tbsp berbere
• 1 onion, sliced
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp ginger
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Season beef with berbere and salt.
2. Heat niter kibbeh over high heat. Sear beef 1-2 min per side. Remove.
3. Sauté onions, pepper, garlic, ginger in same pan.
4. Return beef, toss together. Cook 1 min.
5. Serve immediately with injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Bozena Shiro
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb beef, cubed small
• 1.5 cups chickpea flour (shiro)
• 1 onion, diced
• 1/4 cup berbere
• 1/4 cup oil
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 3 cups water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil. Add beef, brown.
2. Add berbere, garlic, ginger. Cook 3 min.
3. Add water, bring to boil.
4. Whisk in chickpea flour slowly to avoid lumps.
5. Simmer 25 min until thick. Season with salt.
6. Serve over injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 40 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Fitfit
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 pieces injera, torn
• 1/2 cup berbere sauce
• 1/4 cup niter kibbeh
• 1 onion, chopped
• 2 tomatoes, diced
• 1 green chili
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix berbere sauce and niter kibbeh.
2. Add torn injera. Toss to coat.
3. Add onion, tomatoes, chili. Mix well with hands.
4. Let sit 5 min. Serve for breakfast or lunch.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 2

recipes.name: Defo Dabo
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 cups all-purpose flour
• 1 cup warm water
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1 tbsp yeast
• 1 tsp salt
• 2 tbsp oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Sit 5 min.
2. Mix flour, salt. Add yeast mixture and oil. Knead 10 min.
3. Let rise 1 hr. Punch down, shape into round loaf.
4. Place in steamer basket. Steam 40 min.
5. Bread should be fluffy and spongy. Serve warm.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr 15 min | Cook: 40 min | 🍴 Servings: 6-8

recipes.name: Ethiopian Coffee Ceremony
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup green coffee beans
• 3 cups water
• Sugar or cardamom (optional)

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Wash green coffee beans. Roast in pan until dark and aromatic.
2. Grind with mortar and pestle.
3. Add ground coffee to jebena (clay pot) with water. Boil.
4. Let settle, pour into cup and back to strain (repeat 3 times).
5. Pour into small cups. 3 rounds: abol, tona, baraka.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-6

recipes.name: Tej
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 cups honey
• 8 cups water
• 1 packet wine yeast
• 1 cup gesho leaves

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Warm honey and water to dissolve honey. Cool.
2. Add yeast and gesho leaves.
3. Ferment in vessel with airlock 2-3 weeks.
4. Strain and bottle. Age at least 1 month.
5. Serve chilled. Traditional Ethiopian honey wine.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Ferment: 3-4 weeks | 🍴 Yield: 1 gallon

recipes.name: Tella
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs barley malt
• 1 cup gesho leaves
• 1 cup ground corn or millet
• 1 tbsp yeast
• 1 gallon water

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Toast barley malt until golden. Grind coarsely.
2. Boil with water 1 hr. Add gesho leaves, steep 30 min.
3. Strain into fermentation vessel. Cool.
4. Add yeast and ground corn. Ferment 5-7 days.
5. Strain and serve. Traditional Ethiopian beer.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr | Ferment: 5-7 days | 🍴 Yield: 1 gallon

recipes.name: Anchotte
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb potatoes, cubed
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 tbsp oil
• 2 tomatoes, blended
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp cumin
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 cup water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until soft.
2. Add turmeric, cumin, garlic. Cook 2 min.
3. Add tomatoes. Cook 5 min.
4. Add potatoes and water. Cover, simmer 20 min.
5. Season with salt. Serve as a mild side.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Mulukhiyah
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb jute leaves, chopped
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 tbsp niter kibbeh
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 1 green chili
• 1 cup water
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in niter kibbeh until golden.
2. Add garlic, ginger, chili. Cook 2 min.
3. Add chopped leaves, stir.
4. Add water, cover, simmer 15 min.
5. Season with salt. Serve with injera.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Injera
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups teff flour
• 3 cups water
• 1/4 tsp salt
• 1/2 tsp yeast (optional)

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix teff flour with water to thin batter.
2. Cover, ferment 2-3 days at room temp until sour.
3. Stir in salt. Batter should be crepe-like consistency.
4. Heat non-stick pan. Pour ladle of batter, swirl thinly.
5. Do NOT flip. Cover, cook 1-2 min until holes form.
6. Remove and cool. Foundation of every Ethiopian meal.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min + 2-3 days | Cook: 3 min each | 🍴 Yield: 6-8 pieces

recipes.name: Classic Burger
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb ground beef (80/20)
• 4 burger buns
• 4 slices cheese
• Lettuce, tomato, onion
• Ketchup, mustard, mayo
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Divide beef into 4 patties. Season with salt and pepper. Make indent in center.
2. Grill or pan-sear over high heat 3-4 min per side.
3. Top with cheese last minute, cover to melt.
4. Toast buns. Assemble with toppings and condiments.
5. Serve with fries.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 8 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb elbow macaroni
• 4 tbsp butter
• 1/4 cup flour
• 3 cups milk
• 2 cups cheddar, shredded
• 1 cup mozzarella
• 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook macaroni al dente. Drain.
2. Melt butter, whisk in flour until golden (2 min).
3. Gradually whisk in milk. Simmer until thickened.
4. Remove from heat. Stir in cheeses until melted.
5. Season with salt and pepper.
6. Mix sauce with macaroni. Pour into baking dish. Top with breadcrumbs.
7. Bake at 375°F 20 min until bubbly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 6-8

recipes.name: BBQ Ribs
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 racks pork baby back ribs
• 1/4 cup brown sugar
• 2 tbsp paprika
• 1 tbsp garlic powder
• 1 tbsp onion powder
• 1 tsp cayenne
• 2 cups BBQ sauce
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Remove membrane from ribs.
2. Mix dry rub, coat ribs. Wrap in foil.
3. Bake at 275°F for 2.5 hrs.
4. Unwrap, brush with BBQ sauce.
5. Grill or broil 5 min per side until caramelized.
6. Let rest 10 min before cutting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 2 hrs 40 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Buffalo Wings
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs chicken wings
• 1/2 cup hot sauce
• 1/4 cup melted butter
• 1 tbsp vinegar
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• Oil for frying
• Blue cheese dip

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Pat wings dry. Season with salt and garlic powder.
2. Deep fry at 375°F 10-12 min until golden.
3. Or bake at 425°F 45 min, turning once.
4. Mix hot sauce, butter, vinegar. Toss wings to coat.
5. Serve with blue cheese dip and celery.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 12-45 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Cornbread
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup cornmeal
• 1 cup all-purpose flour
• 1/2 cup sugar
• 1 tbsp baking powder
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 1 cup buttermilk
• 2 eggs
• 1/4 cup melted butter

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease 9-inch pan.
2. Mix dry ingredients. Whisk wet ingredients separately.
3. Combine until just mixed. Pour into pan.
4. Bake 20-25 min until golden. Serve warm with butter.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 8

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 1/4 cups flour
• 1 cup butter, softened
• 3/4 cup white sugar
• 3/4 cup brown sugar
• 2 eggs
• 1 tsp vanilla
• 1 tsp baking soda
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 2 cups chocolate chips

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cream butter with sugars until fluffy.
2. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
3. Mix flour, baking soda, salt. Add to butter mixture.
4. Stir in chocolate chips.
5. Drop rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets.
6. Bake at 375°F 9-11 min until golden edges, soft center.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 10 min per batch | 🍴 Yield: 36 cookies

recipes.name: Apple Pie
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 pie crusts
• 6 cups apples, sliced
• 3/4 cup sugar
• 2 tbsp flour
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1/4 tsp nutmeg
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 tbsp butter

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F.
2. Mix apples with sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice.
3. Fill pie crust with apple mixture. Dot with butter.
4. Top with second crust. Crimp edges, cut vents.
5. Bake 15 min at 425°F, then 350°F 35-40 min.
6. Cool completely. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 25 min | Cook: 55 min | 🍴 Servings: 8

recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 cups flour
• 3.5 tsp baking powder
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 1/4 tsp salt
• 1.25 cups milk
• 1 egg
• 3 tbsp melted butter
• Maple syrup

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, salt.
2. Make a well. Add milk, egg, melted butter. Stir until just combined (lumps OK).
3. Heat griddle over medium heat. Lightly butter.
4. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
5. Cook until bubbles form (2-3 min). Flip, cook 1-2 min.
6. Serve with maple syrup and butter.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 6 slices thick bread
• 3 eggs
• 3/4 cup milk
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp vanilla
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon
• Butter
• Maple syrup

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon.
2. Heat butter in pan over medium heat.
3. Dip bread in egg mixture 10 sec per side.
4. Cook 2-3 min per side until golden.
5. Serve with maple syrup, powdered sugar, berries.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 3

recipes.name: Brownies
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1/2 cup butter
• 1 cup sugar
• 2 eggs
• 1 tsp vanilla
• 1/3 cup cocoa powder
• 1/2 cup flour
• 1/4 tsp salt
• 1/4 tsp baking powder

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 8x8 pan.
2. Melt butter. Stir in sugar, eggs, vanilla.
3. Mix cocoa, flour, salt, baking powder. Add to wet.
4. Stir until just combined. Pour into pan.
5. Bake 20-25 min. Toothpick should have moist crumbs.
6. Cool completely. Serve with ice cream.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 9

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Sandwich
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3-4 lb pork shoulder
• 2 tbsp paprika
• 1 tbsp brown sugar
• 1 tbsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 cup BBQ sauce
• 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar
• Burger buns
• Coleslaw

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix dry rub. Coat pork. Rest 30 min.
2. Place pork in Dutch oven. Add BBQ sauce and vinegar.
3. Cover, cook at 300°F 3-4 hrs until fork-tender.
4. Shred with two forks. Mix with juices.
5. Serve on toasted buns with coleslaw.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 4 hrs | 🍴 Servings: 8-10

recipes.name: Potato Salad
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs potatoes, cubed
• 1/2 cup mayonnaise
• 2 tbsp mustard
• 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
• 1/2 onion, diced
• 2 celery stalks, diced
• 1 tbsp vinegar
• Salt, pepper, paprika

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Boil potatoes until tender. Drain and cool.
2. Mix mayo, mustard, vinegar, salt, pepper.
3. Combine potatoes, eggs, onion, celery.
4. Toss with dressing. Refrigerate 1 hr.
5. Sprinkle with paprika before serving.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Coleslaw
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1/2 head green cabbage, shredded
• 2 carrots, grated
• 1/2 cup mayonnaise
• 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp celery seeds
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Shred cabbage. Grate carrots.
2. Whisk mayo, vinegar, sugar, celery seeds, salt, pepper.
3. Toss dressing with vegetables.
4. Refrigerate 1 hr before serving.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Clam Chowder
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cans chopped clams
• 4 slices bacon, diced
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 potatoes, cubed
• 2 cups heavy cream
• 1 cup milk
• 2 tbsp butter
• 2 tbsp flour
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook bacon until crispy. Remove.
2. Sauté onions in bacon fat.
3. Add butter and flour, make roux (2 min).
4. Whisk in clam juice, then milk and cream.
5. Add potatoes. Simmer 15 min until tender.
6. Add clams and bacon. Season. Serve in bread bowls.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Meatloaf
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 lbs ground beef
• 1/2 lb ground pork
• 1 cup breadcrumbs
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 eggs
• 1/4 cup ketchup
• 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl until combined.
2. Shape into a loaf on a baking sheet.
3. Top with extra ketchup.
4. Bake at 350°F for 1 hr.
5. Let rest 10 min before slicing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 1 hr | 🍴 Servings: 6-8

recipes.name: Classic Pizza
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2.5 cups flour
• 1 cup warm water
• 2 tsp yeast
• 1 tsp sugar
• 1 tsp salt
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1/2 cup tomato sauce
• 2 cups mozzarella
• Toppings of choice

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Sit 5 min.
2. Mix flour, salt. Add yeast mixture and oil. Knead 10 min.
3. Let rise 1 hr. Roll out dough.
4. Top with sauce, cheese, toppings.
5. Bake at 475°F 12-15 min until crust is golden.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr 15 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 2-4

recipes.name: Pasta Carbonara
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb spaghetti
• 6 oz guanciale or pancetta
• 4 egg yolks
• 2 whole eggs
• 1 cup pecorino romano, grated
• 1 cup parmesan
• Black pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook spaghetti al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
2. Fry guanciale until crispy.
3. Whisk eggs with cheeses and pepper.
4. Toss hot pasta with guanciale and fat.
5. Add egg mixture off heat, tossing constantly. Add pasta water as needed.
6. Serve immediately with extra cheese.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Lasagna
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 12 lasagna noodles
• 1 lb ground beef
• 2 cups ricotta
• 3 cups mozzarella
• 1 cup parmesan
• 3 cups marinara sauce
• 1 egg
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• Salt, pepper, Italian herbs

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook noodles. Brown beef with onion and garlic.
2. Mix ricotta with egg, salt, herbs.
3. Layer: sauce, noodles, ricotta, beef, mozzarella. Repeat.
4. Top with parmesan. Cover with foil.
5. Bake at 375°F 45 min. Uncover, bake 15 more min.
6. Rest 10 min before cutting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Cook: 1 hr | 🍴 Servings: 8

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• Pizza dough
• 1/2 cup crushed San Marzano tomatoes
• 8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced
• Fresh basil leaves
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Stretch dough into round.
2. Spread crushed tomatoes. Season with salt.
3. Arrange mozzarella slices on top.
4. Bake at highest temp (500°F+) 8-10 min.
5. Top with fresh basil and olive oil. Serve immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 2

recipes.name: Bruschetta
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 baguette, sliced
• 4 ripe tomatoes, diced
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1/4 cup basil, chopped
• 3 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Toast baguette slices until golden. Rub with garlic.
2. Mix diced tomatoes, basil, olive oil, vinegar, salt, pepper.
3. Top each toast with tomato mixture.
4. Serve immediately as an appetizer.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 5 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Risotto
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 cups arborio rice
• 4 cups warm broth
• 1/2 cup white wine
• 1 onion, finely diced
• 3 tbsp butter
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onion in butter until soft.
2. Add rice, toast 2 min until translucent edges.
3. Add wine, stir until absorbed.
4. Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly.
5. Continue 18-20 min until rice is creamy and al dente.
6. Stir in parmesan and remaining butter. Serve immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 6 egg yolks
• 3/4 cup sugar
• 1.25 cups mascarpone
• 2 cups heavy cream
• 2 cups strong espresso, cooled
• 3 tbsp coffee liqueur (optional)
• 30 ladyfinger cookies
• Cocoa powder

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Whisk yolks and sugar until thick. Add mascarpone.
2. Whip cream to stiff peaks. Fold into mascarpone mixture.
3. Mix espresso with liqueur. Dip ladyfingers briefly.
4. Layer dipped ladyfingers and cream mixture in dish.
5. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
6. Dust with cocoa powder before serving.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Chill: 6+ hrs | 🍴 Servings: 8-10

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb fettuccine
• 1/2 cup butter
• 2 cups heavy cream
• 2 cups parmesan, grated
• 4 garlic cloves, minced
• Salt, pepper, nutmeg

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook fettuccine al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
2. Melt butter in pan. Sauté garlic until fragrant.
3. Add cream. Simmer 3 min.
4. Off heat, whisk in parmesan until smooth.
5. Toss with pasta. Add pasta water if needed.
6. Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg. Serve immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 chicken breasts
• 1 cup breadcrumbs
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• 1 cup mozzarella
• 1 cup marinara sauce
• 2 eggs
• 1/2 cup flour
• Salt, pepper, Italian herbs

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Pound chicken to even thickness. Season.
2. Bread: flour, egg, breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
3. Fry in oil 3-4 min per side until golden.
4. Top with marinara and mozzarella.
5. Bake at 400°F 15 min until cheese melts and bubbly.
6. Serve with pasta.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Penne Arrabbiata
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb penne
• 2 cans crushed tomatoes
• 4 garlic cloves, sliced
• 2 dried chilies
• 1/4 cup olive oil
• Fresh parsley
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook penne al dente.
2. Heat olive oil. Sauté garlic and chilies until garlic is golden.
3. Add crushed tomatoes. Simmer 15 min.
4. Remove chilies. Season with salt.
5. Toss with pasta. Garnish with parsley.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 carrots, diced
• 2 celery stalks, diced
• 2 zucchini, cubed
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 1 can cannellini beans
• 1 cup small pasta
• 4 cups vegetable broth
• 2 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• Salt, pepper, Italian herbs

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onion, carrots, celery in olive oil (10 min).
2. Add garlic, zucchini. Cook 3 min.
3. Add tomatoes, broth, herbs. Simmer 20 min.
4. Add pasta and beans. Cook until pasta is tender.
5. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with parmesan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 35 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 ripe tomatoes, sliced
• 8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced
• Fresh basil leaves
• 3 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Alternate slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate.
2. Tuck basil leaves between slices.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
4. Season with salt and pepper. Serve at room temp.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Osso Buco
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 veal shanks
• 1 cup flour
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 carrots, diced
• 2 celery stalks
• 1 cup white wine
• 2 cups beef broth
• 1 can diced tomatoes
• 2 garlic cloves
• Gremolata: lemon zest, parsley, garlic

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dredge veal in flour. Brown in oil.
2. Sauté vegetables. Add wine, reduce.
3. Add tomatoes, broth. Return veal.
4. Cover, simmer 2 hrs until tender.
5. Make gremolata: mix lemon zest, parsley, garlic.
6. Serve over risotto or polenta. Top with gremolata.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 2 hrs | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Cannoli
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups flour
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 2 tbsp butter
• 1 egg
• 1/2 cup sweet Marsala wine
• Oil for frying

FILLING:
• 2 cups ricotta, drained
• 1/2 cup powdered sugar
• 1 tsp vanilla
• 1/2 cup chocolate chips
• Pistachios, chopped

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Make dough: mix flour, sugar, butter, egg, wine. Knead, rest 30 min.
2. Roll thin, cut into circles. Wrap around cannoli tubes.
3. Fry at 375°F until golden. Cool.
4. Mix filling ingredients. Pipe into shells.
5. Dip ends in pistachios. Dust with powdered sugar.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 45 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 12-15

recipes.name: Chicken Tacos
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb chicken thighs
• 8 corn tortillas
• 1 onion, diced
• 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped
• 2 limes
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp chili powder
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Season chicken with cumin, chili, salt, pepper. Grill until cooked.
2. Let rest, then chop into small pieces.
3. Warm tortillas on the grill.
4. Fill tortillas with chicken, onion, cilantro.
5. Squeeze lime juice over. Serve with salsa.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 ripe avocados
• 1 lime, juiced
• 1/2 onion, diced
• 1 jalapeno, minced
• 1/4 cup cilantro, chopped
• 1 tomato, diced
• Salt to taste

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Halve avocados, remove pit. Scoop into bowl.
2. Mash to desired consistency.
3. Mix in lime juice, onion, jalapeno, cilantro, tomato.
4. Season with salt. Serve with chips.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Burritos
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb ground beef
• 4 large flour tortillas
• 1 cup cooked rice
• 1 can black beans
• 1 cup shredded cheese
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 tbsp taco seasoning
• Sour cream, salsa

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Brown beef with onion and taco seasoning.
2. Warm tortillas. Layer rice, beans, beef, cheese.
3. Fold sides in, roll tightly.
4. Toast in dry pan until golden.
5. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Enchiladas
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 8 corn tortillas
• 2 cups cooked chicken, shredded
• 2 cups enchilada sauce
• 2 cups shredded cheese
• 1/2 cup sour cream
• 1 onion, diced
• Cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix chicken with sour cream, onion, half the cheese.
2. Soften tortillas in microwave.
3. Fill each tortilla with chicken mixture. Roll up.
4. Place seam-down in baking dish. Cover with sauce and remaining cheese.
5. Bake at 375°F 20 min until bubbly. Garnish with cilantro.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Quesadillas
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 flour tortillas
• 2 cups shredded cheese (cheddar or Oaxaca)
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 onion, sliced
• 1 jalapeno, sliced
• Sour cream, salsa

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté peppers, onion, jalapeno until soft.
2. Place tortilla in pan. Add cheese, vegetables, more cheese.
3. Top with second tortilla.
4. Cook until golden on each side, cheese melted.
5. Cut into wedges. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 2-4

recipes.name: Churros
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup water
• 1/2 cup butter
• 1/4 cup sugar
• 1 cup flour
• 3 eggs
• 1 tsp vanilla
• Oil for frying
• Cinnamon-sugar for coating
• Chocolate sauce for dipping

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Boil water, butter, sugar. Add flour all at once, stir vigorously.
2. Cool slightly. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add vanilla.
3. Pipe dough into hot oil using star tip.
4. Fry until golden (3-4 min). Drain.
5. Roll in cinnamon-sugar. Serve with chocolate sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Chilaquiles
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 10 corn tortillas, cut into strips
• 2 cups salsa verde
• 2 eggs
• 1/2 cup crema or sour cream
• 1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco
• 1 onion, sliced
• Oil for frying
• Cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Fry tortilla strips until crispy.
2. Heat salsa verde in a pan.
3. Add fried strips to salsa. Toss to coat (30 sec - don't let get soggy).
4. Fry eggs sunny-side up.
5. Serve chilaquiles topped with egg, crema, queso, onion, cilantro.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 2

recipes.name: Pozole
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lb pork shoulder, cubed
• 2 cans hominy, drained
• 1 onion, diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 dried guajillo chilies
• 1 tsp cumin
• 6 cups chicken broth
• Toppings: cabbage, radish, lime, oregano

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Simmer pork in broth with onion, garlic (1 hr).
2. Toast guajillo chilies, soak, blend into paste.
3. Add chili paste, cumin, hominy to pot.
4. Simmer 30 more min until pork is tender.
5. Serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, lime, oregano.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 1 hr 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Tres Leches Cake
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup flour
• 1.5 tsp baking powder
• 1/4 tsp salt
• 5 eggs, separated
• 1 cup sugar
• 1 tsp vanilla
• 1/3 cup milk

THREE MILKS:
• 1 can evaporated milk
• 1 can sweetened condensed milk
• 1 cup heavy cream

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Beat egg whites with 3/4 cup sugar until stiff peaks.
2. Beat yolks with remaining sugar, vanilla, milk.
3. Fold in flour mixture. Fold in egg whites.
4. Bake at 350°F 25-30 min. Cool.
5. Mix three milks. Pour over cooled cake.
6. Refrigerate at least 4 hrs. Top with whipped cream.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Bake: 30 min + 4 hrs chill | 🍴 Servings: 10

recipes.name: Tamales
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups masa harina
• 1 cup lard or shortening
• 1.5 cups broth
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1 tsp salt
• Dried corn husks
• 1 lb pork, cooked and shredded
• 1 cup red chili sauce

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak corn husks in warm water until soft.
2. Beat lard until fluffy. Mix masa, broth, baking powder, salt into dough.
3. Spread dough on husk. Add pork and chili sauce.
4. Fold sides in, fold up bottom. Steam upright 1 hr.
5. Dough should pull away from husk when done.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 45 min | Cook: 1 hr | 🍴 Servings: 12-15

recipes.name: Elote
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 ears corn, husked
• 1/2 cup mayonnaise
• 1/2 cup cotija cheese, crumbled
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1 lime
• Cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Grill or boil corn until charred and tender.
2. Brush with mayonnaise.
3. Sprinkle with cotija cheese and chili powder.
4. Squeeze lime juice over. Garnish with cilantro.
5. Serve on a stick. Mexican street corn!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Margarita
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 oz tequila
• 1 oz lime juice
• 1 oz triple sec
• 1/2 oz agave syrup
• Ice
• Salt for rim
• Lime wheel

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Rub lime wedge on rim of glass. Dip in salt.
2. Fill shaker with ice. Add tequila, lime juice, triple sec, agave.
3. Shake vigorously 15 sec.
4. Strain into prepared glass over fresh ice.
5. Garnish with lime wheel.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 1

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs chicken, cut up
• 2 onions, diced
• 3 tomatoes, blended
• 4 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tsp cumin
• 2 tsp coriander
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1/2 cup yogurt
• 3 tbsp oil
• Salt, cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until golden.
2. Add garlic, ginger, spices. Cook 2 min.
3. Add tomatoes. Cook until oil separates.
4. Add chicken. Brown on all sides.
5. Add yogurt, cover. Simmer 25 min until chicken is cooked.
6. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with rice or naan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 35 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 lbs chicken thighs
• 2 tbsp butter
• 1 cup heavy cream
• 1 cup tomato puree
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tsp garam masala
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp chili powder
• Salt, cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices 1 hr. Grill or bake until charred. Cut into pieces.
2. Sauté onion in butter. Add garlic, ginger, garam masala.
3. Add tomato puree. Simmer 10 min.
4. Add cream and chicken. Simmer 10 more min.
5. Season with salt. Garnish with cilantro and more butter. Serve with naan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr + 15 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Biryani
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups basmati rice
• 1 lb chicken, cubed
• 2 onions, sliced
• 1/2 cup yogurt
• 2 tsp biryani masala
• 1 tsp turmeric
• Saffron soaked in milk
• 4 cups water
• Ghee, salt, cilantro
• Whole spices: cardamom, cloves, cinnamon

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices 30 min.
2. Fry onions in ghee until crispy. Set aside.
3. Layer in pot: rice, chicken, onions, saffron milk. Repeat.
4. Add water. Bring to boil. Cover tightly.
5. Cook on low 25 min. Let rest 5 min.
6. Gently fluff. Serve with raita.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 40 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 8 oz paneer, cubed
• 1 lb spinach
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 green chilies
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp garam masala
• 1/2 cup cream
• 2 tbsp ghee
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Blanch spinach. Blend into smooth puree.
2. Sauté onion in ghee. Add garlic, ginger, chilies.
3. Add cumin, garam masala. Cook 1 min.
4. Add spinach puree. Simmer 10 min.
5. Add cream and paneer. Cook 5 more min.
6. Season with salt. Serve with naan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup black lentils (urad dal)
• 1/4 cup kidney beans
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 tomatoes, blended
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1/4 cup cream
• 3 tbsp butter
• Salt, cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak lentils and beans overnight. Boil until soft.
2. Sauté onion in butter. Add garlic, ginger, spices.
3. Add tomato puree. Cook until thick.
4. Add cooked lentils. Simmer 30 min.
5. Stir in cream. Season with salt.
6. Garnish with butter and cilantro. Serve with naan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 8 hrs soaking | Cook: 1 hr | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Rogan Josh
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs lamb, cubed
• 2 onions, diced
• 1 cup yogurt
• 2 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
• 2 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp coriander
• 4 cardamom pods
• 1 cinnamon stick
• 3 tbsp ghee
• Salt, saffron

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Brown lamb in ghee. Remove.
2. Sauté onions until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, spices.
3. Return lamb. Add yogurt. Cook 5 min.
4. Add 2 cups water. Cover, simmer 1 hr until lamb is tender.
5. Season with salt. Garnish with saffron.
6. Serve with rice or naan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 1 hr 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Samosas
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups flour
• 1/4 cup oil
• 1/2 cup water
• 1/2 tsp salt

FILLING:
• 3 potatoes, boiled and mashed
• 1/2 cup peas
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 green chilies
• 1 tsp cumin seeds
• 1 tsp garam masala
• 1/2 tsp turmeric
• Salt, cilantro, oil for frying

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, oil, salt, water into stiff dough. Rest 30 min.
2. Sauté onion, cumin, chilies. Add peas, spices, mashed potatoes.
3. Roll dough into circles. Cut in half. Form cones.
4. Fill with potato mixture. Seal edges.
5. Deep fry until golden. Serve with chutney.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 45 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 12-15

recipes.name: Naan
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 cups flour
• 1 tsp yeast
• 1 tsp sugar
• 1/2 cup warm milk
• 1/2 cup yogurt
• 2 tbsp ghee
• 1 tsp salt
• Garlic, butter for topping

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm milk. Sit 10 min.
2. Mix flour, salt. Add yeast mixture, yogurt, ghee.
3. Knead 10 min. Let rise 1 hr until doubled.
4. Divide into balls. Roll into teardrop shapes.
5. Cook in hot cast iron pan until bubbles form. Flip and cook.
6. Brush with garlic butter. Serve hot.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 1 hr 20 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 6-8

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cans chickpeas, drained
• 2 onions, diced
• 3 tomatoes, blended
• 4 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tsp cumin
• 2 tsp coriander
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp garam masala
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 2 tbsp oil
• Salt, cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onions in oil until golden.
2. Add garlic, ginger, spices. Cook 2 min.
3. Add tomato puree. Cook until oil separates.
4. Add chickpeas and 1 cup water. Simmer 20 min.
5. Mash some chickpeas to thicken.
6. Season with salt. Garnish with cilantro. Serve with rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 whole chicken, skin removed, scored
• 1 cup yogurt
• 2 tbsp tandoori masala
• 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp turmeric
• Juice of 1 lemon
• Salt, oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix yogurt with all spices, lemon juice, salt.
2. Coat chicken thoroughly. Marinate overnight.
3. Preheat oven or grill to high heat.
4. Cook chicken 20-25 min, turning once, until charred and cooked through.
5. Brush with oil. Serve with mint chutney and onion rings.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 8 hrs marinate | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup mango pulp
• 1 cup yogurt
• 1/2 cup cold milk
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1/4 tsp cardamom
• Ice cubes

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Blend all ingredients until smooth.
2. Pour into glasses over ice.
3. Garnish with a pinch of cardamom.
4. Serve chilled. A refreshing Indian yogurt drink.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 2

recipes.name: Vegetable Pakora
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup chickpea flour (besan)
• 1 potato, sliced thin
• 1 onion, sliced
• 1 cup spinach
• 1 tsp cumin seeds
• 1 tsp chili powder
• 1/2 tsp turmeric
• 1/2 tsp baking powder
• Water to make batter
• Oil for frying
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix chickpea flour with spices, baking powder, salt. Add water to make thick batter.
2. Add vegetables. Coat well.
3. Deep fry spoonfuls at 350°F until golden and crispy (4-5 min).
4. Drain on paper towels.
5. Serve hot with mint or tamarind chutney.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Fried Rice
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 cups cooked rice, day-old
• 2 eggs, beaten
• 1 cup mixed vegetables
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tsp ginger
• Green onions, salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Scramble eggs in hot oil. Remove.
2. Sauté garlic, ginger, vegetables.
3. Add rice. Stir-fry 3 min.
4. Add soy sauce, sesame oil. Toss.
5. Return eggs. Mix well.
6. Garnish with green onions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
• 1/2 cup peanuts
• 3 dried chilies
• 1 bell pepper, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 2 tbsp vinegar
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 1 tbsp cornstarch
• Oil, green onions

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch for sauce.
2. Stir-fry chicken until golden. Remove.
3. Fry chilies, garlic, ginger, bell pepper.
4. Return chicken. Add sauce and peanuts.
5. Toss until sauce thickens. Drizzle sesame oil.
6. Garnish with green onions. Serve with rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 block silken tofu, cubed
• 1/2 lb ground pork (optional)
• 2 tbsp doubanjiang (chili bean paste)
• 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 1 cup broth
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp cornstarch
• Green onions, oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Blanch tofu in hot water 2 min. Drain.
2. Fry pork until browned (or skip for vegan).
3. Add doubanjiang, garlic, ginger. Fry 1 min.
4. Add broth, soy sauce, tofu. Simmer 5 min.
5. Add cornstarch slurry to thicken.
6. Sprinkle Sichuan pepper and green onions. Serve with rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Spring Rolls
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 pack spring roll wrappers
• 2 cups cabbage, shredded
• 1 carrot, julienned
• 1 cup bean sprouts
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• Oil for frying
• Sweet chili sauce

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Stir-fry vegetables with soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger. Cool.
2. Place filling on wrapper. Fold and roll tightly.
3. Seal edges with water.
4. Deep fry at 350°F 3-4 min until golden.
5. Drain. Serve hot with sweet chili sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 10-12

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
• 1/4 cup soy sauce
• 1/4 cup brown sugar
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tbsp cornstarch
• 4 green onions, cut into 2-inch pieces
• 2 tbsp oil
• 1 tsp sesame oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Toss beef with cornstarch.
2. Fry beef in hot oil until crispy. Remove.
3. Sauté garlic, ginger.
4. Add soy sauce, brown sugar. Simmer until syrupy.
5. Return beef, add green onions. Toss.
6. Drizzle sesame oil. Serve with rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Dim Sum
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb ground pork
• 1/2 cup shrimp, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 1 tsp sugar
• Round dumpling wrappers
• Soy sauce, vinegar, chili oil for dipping

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix pork, shrimp, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar.
2. Place filling in center of wrapper. Pleat edges to seal.
3. Steam dumplings 8-10 min until cooked through.
4. Serve in bamboo steamer with dipping sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 20-24

recipes.name: Char Siu
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lb pork shoulder
• 3 tbsp honey
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp hoisin sauce
• 1 tbsp oyster sauce
• 1 tsp five spice
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 2 garlic cloves
• Red food coloring (optional)

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix all ingredients (except pork) for marinade.
2. Marinate pork overnight.
3. Roast at 375°F 30 min. Baste with marinade.
4. Turn, roast 20 more min basting twice.
5. Broil 3 min for caramelized edges.
6. Slice thin. Serve with rice or in bao buns.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 8 hrs marinate | Cook: 55 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Wonton Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 pack wonton wrappers
• 1/2 lb ground pork
• 1/2 cup shrimp, minced
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 4 cups chicken broth
• Green onions, bok choy

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix pork, shrimp, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil.
2. Fill wonton wrappers. Fold and seal.
3. Bring broth to boil. Add wontons.
4. Cook 4-5 min until wontons float.
5. Add bok choy. Garnish with green onions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 25 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Hot and Sour Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 6 cups chicken broth
• 1/2 cup bamboo shoots
• 1/2 cup mushrooms, sliced
• 1 block tofu, julienned
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 3 tbsp vinegar
• 1 tsp white pepper
• 2 eggs, beaten
• 2 tbsp cornstarch
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• Green onions

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Bring broth to boil. Add bamboo shoots, mushrooms, tofu.
2. Add soy sauce, vinegar, white pepper.
3. Thicken with cornstarch slurry.
4. Drizzle in beaten eggs, stirring gently.
5. Drizzle sesame oil. Garnish with green onions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Egg Drop Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 cups chicken broth
• 3 eggs, beaten
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• 1 tbsp cornstarch
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• Green onions
• White pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Bring broth to boil with ginger and soy sauce.
2. Add cornstarch slurry. Stir until slightly thickened.
3. Slowly drizzle in eggs while stirring in one direction.
4. Season with white pepper and sesame oil.
5. Garnish with green onions. Serve immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Sushi Rolls
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups sushi rice
• 2.5 cups water
• 1/4 cup rice vinegar
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp salt
• 4 nori sheets
• Cucumber, avocado
• 8 oz raw salmon or tuna
• Soy sauce, wasabi, pickled ginger

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook rice. Mix vinegar, sugar, salt. Fold into hot rice. Cool.
2. Place nori on bamboo mat. Spread rice thinly, leaving 1 inch at top.
3. Add fillings in a line across the center.
4. Roll tightly using the mat. Seal edge with water.
5. Slice into rounds with sharp knife.
6. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, pickled ginger.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4 rolls

recipes.name: Miso Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 cups dashi stock
• 3 tbsp white miso paste
• 1 block silken tofu, cubed
• 2 green onions, sliced
• 1 sheet wakame seaweed

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Bring dashi to a gentle simmer.
2. Add wakame and tofu. Heat 2 min.
3. Remove from heat. Dissolve miso paste in a ladle of broth.
4. Return to pot. Do NOT boil after adding miso.
5. Serve in bowls garnished with green onions.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 5 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 chicken thighs
• 1/4 cup soy sauce
• 1/4 cup mirin
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1 tbsp sake (optional)
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• 2 garlic cloves
• Sesame seeds, green onions

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, sake, ginger, garlic for sauce.
2. Score chicken thighs. Pan-fry skin-side down until crispy.
3. Flip, cook 3 more min. Drain excess fat.
4. Pour sauce over. Simmer until thick and glossy (3-4 min).
5. Slice and drizzle remaining sauce.
6. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Tempura
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 8 large shrimp, peeled (tails on)
• Assorted vegetables (sweet potato, broccoli, zucchini)
• 1 cup flour
• 1 egg yolk
• 1 cup ice-cold soda water
• Oil for frying
• Tempura dipping sauce

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Make batter: mix flour, egg yolk, soda water. Keep cold and lumpy.
2. Heat oil to 350°F.
3. Dip shrimp and vegetables in batter. Fry 2-3 min until light golden.
4. Drain on paper towels.
5. Serve immediately with tempura dipping sauce and grated daikon.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup flour
• 1 cup water
• 2 eggs
• 3 cups cabbage, shredded
• 1/2 cup green onions
• 1/2 lb pork belly, sliced thin
• Okonomiyaki sauce
• Japanese mayo
• Bonito flakes, aonori

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, water, eggs into batter. Add cabbage, green onions.
2. Pour onto hot oiled griddle. Top with pork slices.
3. Cook 4-5 min per side until golden and cooked through.
4. Drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and mayo.
5. Sprinkle with bonito flakes and aonori. Serve hot.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 2

recipes.name: Ramen
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 packs ramen noodles
• 6 cups pork or chicken broth
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp miso
• 1 tsp sesame oil
• Toppings: sliced pork, soft-boiled egg, nori, green onions, corn

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Simmer broth with soy sauce, miso, sesame oil.
2. Cook ramen noodles according to package.
3. Place noodles in bowls. Ladle hot broth over.
4. Top with sliced pork, halved soft-boiled egg, nori, green onions.
5. Serve immediately. Customize with chili oil or garlic.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Gyoza
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 pack gyoza wrappers
• 1/2 lb ground pork
• 1 cup cabbage, minced
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• Oil for frying
• Dipping sauce: soy sauce, vinegar, chili oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix pork, cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil.
2. Place filling on wrapper. Pleat and seal.
3. Heat oil in pan. Place gyoza flat-side down. Fry 2 min until golden.
4. Add 1/4 cup water. Cover, steam 4 min.
5. Uncover, cook until water evaporates and bottoms crisp.
6. Serve with dipping sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 20-24

recipes.name: Tonkatsu
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 pork loin chops
• 1 cup flour
• 2 eggs, beaten
• 2 cups panko breadcrumbs
• Oil for frying
• Salt, pepper
• Tonkatsu sauce
• Shredded cabbage

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Pound pork to even thickness. Season with salt, pepper.
2. Bread: flour, egg, panko. Press panko firmly.
3. Deep fry at 350°F 4-5 min per side until golden and cooked through.
4. Drain. Slice into strips.
5. Serve with shredded cabbage and tonkatsu sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 8 oz rice noodles
• 1/2 lb shrimp
• 2 eggs
• 3 tbsp fish sauce
• 3 tbsp tamarind paste
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1 tbsp lime juice
• 1 cup bean sprouts
• 1/4 cup peanuts, crushed
• 3 garlic cloves
• 2 green onions
• Oil, chili flakes

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak noodles 30 min. Drain.
2. Make sauce: fish sauce, tamarind, sugar, lime juice.
3. Stir-fry shrimp. Remove. Scramble eggs in same pan.
4. Add garlic, noodles, sauce. Toss 2 min.
5. Return shrimp. Add bean sprouts. Toss.
6. Serve garnished with peanuts, green onions, chili flakes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 35 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1/2 lb shrimp
• 4 cups chicken broth
• 2 lemongrass stalks, bruised
• 3 kaffir lime leaves
• 1 tbsp galangal, sliced
• 3 Thai chilies
• 2 tbsp fish sauce
• 2 tbsp lime juice
• 1 tbsp chili paste
• 1 cup mushrooms
• Cilantro

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Bring broth to boil. Add lemongrass, lime leaves, galangal, chilies.
2. Simmer 5 min. Add mushrooms.
3. Add shrimp. Cook 2 min until pink.
4. Stir in fish sauce, lime juice, chili paste.
5. Remove from heat. Garnish with cilantro. Serve hot.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Green Curry
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb chicken thighs, sliced
• 2 tbsp green curry paste
• 1 can coconut milk
• 1 cup bamboo shoots
• 1 cup Thai basil
• 1 cup vegetables (bell pepper, green beans)
• 2 tbsp fish sauce
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 2 kaffir lime leaves

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Heat 1/2 can coconut milk. Stir in curry paste until fragrant.
2. Add chicken. Cook 5 min.
3. Add remaining coconut milk, vegetables, bamboo shoots.
4. Add fish sauce, sugar, lime leaves. Simmer 10 min.
5. Stir in Thai basil. Serve with jasmine rice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup glutinous rice
• 1 can coconut milk
• 1/2 cup sugar
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 2 ripe mangoes, sliced
• Sesame seeds or mung beans for garnish

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak rice overnight. Steam 20-25 min until tender.
2. Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt (don't boil).
3. Pour most of coconut milk over hot rice. Mix gently. Cover 15 min.
4. Slice mangoes.
5. Serve rice with mango slices. Drizzle with remaining coconut sauce.
6. Garnish with sesame seeds.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 8 hrs soaking | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Pad See Ew
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 8 oz wide rice noodles
• 1/2 lb chicken, sliced
• 2 eggs
• 2 cups Chinese broccoli
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak noodles 15 min. Drain.
2. Mix soy sauces and sugar.
3. Stir-fry chicken until cooked. Remove.
4. Fry garlic and broccoli. Add noodles, sauce. Toss 2 min.
5. Push noodles aside. Scramble eggs in same pan.
6. Return chicken. Toss everything together. Serve hot.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 3-4

recipes.name: Pho
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb beef bones
• 1 lb beef sirloin, thinly sliced
• 1 pack rice noodles
• 1 onion, halved
• 1 piece ginger
• 2 star anise
• 1 cinnamon stick
• 3 tbsp fish sauce
• Bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime, hoisin, sriracha

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Char onion and ginger under broiler.
2. Simmer beef bones, onion, ginger, star anise, cinnamon in water 3 hrs.
3. Strain broth. Season with fish sauce.
4. Cook noodles. Place in bowls.
5. Arrange raw beef slices on top. Ladle boiling broth over (cooks the beef).
6. Serve with bean sprouts, basil, lime, hoisin, sriracha.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 3 hrs | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Vietnamese Spring Rolls
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 12 rice paper wrappers
• 1/2 lb shrimp, cooked and halved
• Rice vermicelli noodles
• Lettuce, mint, cilantro
• 1 carrot, julienned
• 1 cucumber, julienned
• Peanut dipping sauce

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cook noodles. Cool.
2. Dip rice paper in warm water until soft.
3. Layer on surface: lettuce, noodles, herbs, carrot, cucumber, shrimp.
4. Fold sides in, roll tightly.
5. Serve with peanut dipping sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 5 min | 🍴 Servings: 12 rolls

recipes.name: Kimchi
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 napa cabbage
• 1/4 cup salt
• 4 cups water

PASTE:
• 3 tbsp gochugaru (Korean chili flakes)
• 2 tbsp fish sauce
• 1 tbsp garlic, minced
• 1 tsp ginger
• 2 green onions
• 1 carrot, julienned

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Cut cabbage. Soak in salt water 2 hrs, turning occasionally.
2. Rinse thoroughly. Drain.
3. Mix chili paste ingredients.
4. Rub paste between cabbage leaves.
5. Pack into jar. Press down. Leave at room temp 1-2 days.
6. Refrigerate. Fermentation continues slowly. Best after 1 week.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Ferment: 1-2 days | 🍴 Yield: 1 quart

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups cooked rice
• 1/2 lb beef, sliced
• 4 eggs
• Assorted vegetables (spinach, carrots, bean sprouts, mushrooms, zucchini)
• 3 tbsp gochujang
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• Sesame seeds

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate beef in soy sauce, sesame oil. Stir-fry.
2. Sauté each vegetable separately.
3. Fry eggs sunny-side up.
4. Place rice in bowl. Arrange vegetables and beef on top.
5. Top with egg. Add gochujang and sesame oil.
6. Mix everything together before eating.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 20 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Bulgogi
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb ribeye, thinly sliced
• 1/4 cup soy sauce
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1 tbsp sesame oil
• 3 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp ginger
• 1/2 pear, grated
• 2 green onions
• Sesame seeds

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, pear.
2. Marinate beef 30 min.
3. Grill or pan-fry over high heat 2-3 min per side.
4. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
5. Serve with rice and lettuce wraps.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 35 min | Cook: 5 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs chicken wings or drumettes
• 1/2 cup cornstarch
• 1/2 cup flour
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tsp pepper
• Oil for frying

SAUCE:
• 3 tbsp gochujang
• 2 tbsp honey
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tbsp vinegar
• 2 garlic cloves
• Sesame seeds

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper. Coat chicken.
2. Double-fry: first at 320°F 8 min, rest 5 min, second at 350°F 5 min until extra crispy.
3. Mix sauce ingredients in a pan. Simmer until thick.
4. Toss hot chicken in sauce.
5. Garnish with sesame seeds. Serve immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 zucchini, sliced
• 1 eggplant, cubed
• 2 bell peppers, diced
• 1 onion, diced
• 4 tomatoes, chopped
• 4 garlic cloves
• 1/4 cup olive oil
• Herbes de Provence
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
2. Add peppers. Cook 5 min.
3. Add eggplant. Cook 5 min.
4. Add zucchini and tomatoes. Add herbs.
5. Simmer 30 min until vegetables are tender and flavors meld.
6. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot or at room temp.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 45 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 pie crust
• 6 oz bacon, diced
• 3 eggs
• 1.5 cups heavy cream
• 1 cup gruyere, grated
• 1/4 tsp nutmeg
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F. Blind bake pie crust 10 min.
2. Cook bacon until crispy. Sprinkle in crust with cheese.
3. Whisk eggs, cream, nutmeg, salt, pepper.
4. Pour over bacon and cheese.
5. Bake 35-40 min until set and golden.
6. Cool 10 min before slicing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 50 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Croissants
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3.5 cups flour
• 1 cup warm milk
• 2 tsp yeast
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp salt
• 1.25 cups cold butter
• 1 egg for wash

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, milk into dough. Rest 1 hr.
2. Roll dough into rectangle. Place cold butter slab in center. Fold and seal.
3. Roll and fold (3 folds total), chilling 30 min between each.
4. Roll into large rectangle. Cut triangles.
5. Roll each triangle from base to tip. Curve into crescent.
6. Proof 2 hrs. Brush with egg wash.
7. Bake at 400°F 15-18 min until golden and flaky.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 4+ hrs | Cook: 18 min | 🍴 Yield: 12-14

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 6 large onions, thinly sliced
• 4 tbsp butter
• 4 cups beef broth
• 1 cup white wine
• 1 tsp thyme
• 1 bay leaf
• Baguette slices
• 2 cups gruyere, grated
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Caramelize onions in butter over low heat 45 min until deep golden.
2. Add wine. Simmer until reduced.
3. Add broth, thyme, bay leaf. Simmer 20 min.
4. Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf.
5. Ladle into oven-safe bowls. Top with baguette and cheese.
6. Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 1 hr 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Coq au Vin
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 4 chicken legs
• 2 cups red wine
• 1 cup mushrooms
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 carrots, diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp tomato paste
• 2 cups chicken broth
• 4 bacon slices
• Thyme, bay leaf
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate chicken in wine 2 hrs.
2. Cook bacon until crispy. Remove.
3. Brown chicken in bacon fat. Remove.
4. Sauté vegetables. Add tomato paste. Cook 2 min.
5. Add wine, broth, herbs, chicken, bacon.
6. Cover, simmer 45 min until chicken is tender.
7. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over mashed potatoes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 2 hrs marinate | Cook: 1 hr | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Crepes
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup flour
• 2 eggs
• 1.5 cups milk
• 2 tbsp melted butter
• 1 tbsp sugar
• 1 tsp vanilla
• Pinch salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Whisk all ingredients until smooth. Rest 30 min.
2. Heat non-stick pan over medium. Lightly butter.
3. Pour 1/4 cup batter, swirl to coat thinly.
4. Cook 1 min per side until lightly golden.
5. Fill with Nutella, fruit, cream cheese, or savory fillings.
6. Fold or roll. Dust with powdered sugar.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 35 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 8-10

recipes.name: Bouillabaisse
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs mixed fish and seafood
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 leeks, sliced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 tomatoes, chopped
• 1 fennel bulb, sliced
• 1 cup white wine
• 4 cups fish stock
• Saffron
• Rouille, croutons

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onion, leeks, garlic, fennel in olive oil.
2. Add tomatoes, wine. Simmer 5 min.
3. Add stock and saffron. Simmer 20 min.
4. Add fish first, then seafood. Cook 5 min until just done.
5. Serve with rouille-topped croutons.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 35 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Beef Bourguignon
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs beef chuck, cubed
• 2 cups red wine
• 2 cups beef broth
• 2 tbsp tomato paste
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 carrots, diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 1 cup mushrooms
• 4 bacon slices
• Thyme, bay leaf
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate beef in wine 2 hrs.
2. Cook bacon. Remove. Brown beef in batches. Remove.
3. Sauté vegetables. Add tomato paste.
4. Add beef, wine, broth, bacon, herbs.
5. Bring to boil. Cover, simmer 2 hrs.
6. Add mushrooms. Cook 30 more min.
7. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over mashed potatoes or pasta.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 2 hrs marinate | Cook: 2.5 hrs | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cans chickpeas, drained
• 1/4 cup tahini
• 3 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 garlic cloves
• 1/4 cup olive oil
• 1/2 tsp cumin
• Salt, water as needed
• Paprika, parsley for garnish

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Blend tahini with lemon juice and garlic until light.
2. Add chickpeas, olive oil, cumin, salt. Blend until smooth.
3. Add ice water gradually for creamy texture.
4. Adjust seasoning. Spread on plate.
5. Drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle paprika and parsley.
6. Serve with warm pita bread.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Falafel
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked overnight
• 1 onion, chopped
• 4 garlic cloves
• 1 cup parsley, chopped
• 2 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp coriander
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1 tsp salt
• 1/2 tsp chili flakes
• Oil for frying

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Drain chickpeas. Blend with onion, garlic, parsley, spices until coarse paste.
2. Add baking powder. Refrigerate 30 min.
3. Shape into balls or patties.
4. Deep fry at 350°F 4-5 min until deep golden and crispy.
5. Serve in pita with tahini sauce, veggies, pickles.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 8 hrs soaking | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Shawarma
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs chicken thighs
• 3 tbsp yogurt
• 2 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 2 tsp cumin
• 2 tsp paprika
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• Pita bread, tahini, pickles, tomatoes

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Mix yogurt, lemon juice, oil, spices. Marinate chicken 2 hrs.
2. Grill or pan-fry chicken until charred and cooked through.
3. Rest, then slice thinly.
4. Warm pita. Fill with chicken.
5. Top with tahini sauce, pickles, tomatoes. Roll tightly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 2 hrs marinate | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Baba Ganoush
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 large eggplants
• 1/4 cup tahini
• 3 tbsp lemon juice
• 2 garlic cloves
• 3 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp cumin
• Salt, parsley
• Pomegranate seeds (optional)

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Prick eggplants. Roast whole at 400°F 40 min until soft and charred.
2. Let cool. Scoop out flesh. Drain excess liquid.
3. Blend eggplant with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, cumin, salt.
4. Adjust consistency and seasoning.
5. Drizzle with olive oil. Garnish with parsley and pomegranate seeds.
6. Serve with warm pita.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 40 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1/2 cup fine bulgur
• 2 cups parsley, finely chopped
• 1/2 cup mint, chopped
• 3 tomatoes, diced
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1/2 cup green onions
• 1/4 cup lemon juice
• 1/4 cup olive oil
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak bulgur in water 15 min. Drain well.
2. Mix bulgur with parsley, mint, tomatoes, cucumber, green onions.
3. Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper.
4. Pour dressing over salad. Toss well.
5. Refrigerate 30 min before serving.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Chill: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Baklava
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 pack phyllo dough
• 2 cups mixed nuts (walnuts, pistachios)
• 1 cup butter, melted
• 1 tsp cinnamon

SYRUP:
• 1 cup sugar
• 1 cup water
• 1/2 cup honey
• 1 tsp lemon juice
• 1 cinnamon stick

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Chop nuts with cinnamon.
2. Layer phyllo in buttered pan, brushing each sheet with butter. Every 3-4 sheets, add nut layer.
3. Repeat until all used. Cut into diamonds.
4. Bake at 350°F 45 min until golden.
5. Make syrup: boil sugar, water, honey, lemon, cinnamon until thickened. Cool.
6. Pour cooled syrup over hot baklava. Let absorb overnight.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Cook: 45 min + overnight | 🍴 Servings: 20-24

recipes.name: Kibbeh
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 cup fine bulgur
• 1 lb ground beef
• 1 onion, grated
• 2 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tsp allspice
• Salt, pepper, pine nuts, oil

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak bulgur in water 20 min. Squeeze dry.
2. Mix bulgur with half the beef, onion, spices. Process until paste.
3. Sauté remaining beef with pine nuts for filling.
4. Form bulgur mixture into balls. Make hole, fill with meat mixture. Seal.
5. Shape into ovals. Deep fry until golden.
6. Serve with yogurt sauce.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 30 min | Cook: 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 12-15

recipes.name: Fattoush
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 pita breads, toasted and broken
• 2 tomatoes, diced
• 1 cucumber, diced
• 1/2 head romaine, chopped
• 1/2 cup radish, sliced
• 1/2 cup mint, chopped
• 1/2 cup parsley

DRESSING:
• 1/4 cup olive oil
• 2 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tbsp sumac
• 1 garlic clove
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients together.
2. Combine all vegetables and herbs in a bowl.
3. Add toasted pita pieces.
4. Pour dressing over. Toss well.
5. Serve immediately to keep pita crunchy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 5 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 3 tomatoes, wedges
• 1 cucumber, chunks
• 1 red onion, sliced
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 1/2 cup kalamata olives
• 8 oz feta cheese, block
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 3 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp red wine vinegar
• Salt and pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Arrange vegetables on a platter.
2. Place feta block on top. Sprinkle oregano.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Serve with crusty bread.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 0 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Spanakopita
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 pack phyllo dough
• 1 lb spinach, chopped
• 2 cups feta, crumbled
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 eggs
• 1/2 cup dill, chopped
• 1/2 cup butter, melted
• Salt, pepper, nutmeg

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté onion. Add spinach until wilted. Drain. Cool.
2. Mix spinach with feta, eggs, dill, salt, pepper, nutmeg.
3. Layer phyllo in pan, brushing each sheet with butter.
4. Spread spinach filling. Top with more buttered phyllo.
5. Score top layers. Bake at 375°F 40 min until golden.
6. Cool 10 min before cutting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 45 min | 🍴 Servings: 8-10

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 large eggplants, sliced
• 1 lb ground beef
• 1 onion, diced
• 3 garlic cloves
• 2 cups tomato sauce
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tsp allspice
• 1/4 cup red wine
• 3 tbsp butter
• 3 tbsp flour
• 2 cups milk
• 2 eggs
• 1/2 cup parmesan
• Salt, pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Salt eggplant slices. Drain 30 min. Pat dry. Fry until golden.
2. Brown beef with onion, garlic. Add tomato sauce, wine, spices. Simmer 20 min.
3. Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk flour, gradually add milk. Cook until thick. Off heat, stir in eggs and parmesan.
4. Layer: eggplant, meat sauce, eggplant, béchamel.
5. Bake at 350°F 45 min until golden. Rest 15 min before serving.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 40 min | Cook: 1 hr 15 min | 🍴 Servings: 8

recipes.name: Tzatziki
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups Greek yogurt
• 1 cucumber, grated
