• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp dill or mint
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Grate cucumber. Squeeze out excess water.
2. Mix yogurt with cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, herbs, salt.
3. Refrigerate 1 hr for flavors to meld.
4. Drizzle with olive oil. Serve with pita or grilled meats.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Chill: 1 hr | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Gyros
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 lbs pork or chicken, sliced thin
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 2 tsp oregano
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• 1 tsp paprika
• Salt, pepper, lemon juice
• Pita bread
• Tzatziki, tomatoes, onion, fries

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate meat in oil, oregano, garlic, paprika, salt, pepper, lemon juice 2 hrs.
2. Grill or pan-fry over high heat until charred and cooked through.
3. Warm pita. Layer meat, tzatziki, tomatoes, onion, fries.
4. Roll tightly in foil. Serve with extra tzatziki.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 2 hrs marinate | Cook: 10 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Souvlaki
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 lbs pork shoulder, cubed
• 1/4 cup olive oil
• 1/4 cup lemon juice
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 tsp oregano
• 1 tsp thyme
• Salt, pepper
• Pita, tzatziki, tomatoes, onion

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Whisk oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, pepper. Marinate pork 2 hrs.
2. Thread onto skewers.
3. Grill over high heat 10-12 min, turning, until charred and cooked.
4. Serve on warm pita with tzatziki, tomatoes, onion.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 2 hrs marinate | Cook: 12 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb cod fillets
• 1 cup flour
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1 cup cold beer
• 1 egg
• Salt, pepper
• 4 large potatoes, cut into thick chips
• Oil for frying
• Malt vinegar, tartar sauce

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Soak chips in cold water 30 min. Dry. Fry at 325°F 5 min. Drain.
2. Increase oil to 375°F. Fry chips again 3 min until crispy. Season.
3. For fish: mix flour, baking powder, salt, pepper. Whisk in beer and egg until smooth.
4. Dip fish in batter. Fry at 375°F 5-6 min until golden and crispy.
5. Serve with chips, malt vinegar, tartar sauce, mushy peas.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 25 min | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Paella
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 cups paella rice
• 1/2 lb shrimp
• 1/2 lb mussels
• 1/2 lb chicken, cubed
• 1 onion, diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 tomatoes, grated
• 4 cups broth
• 1 tsp saffron
• 1 tsp paprika
• 1/2 cup peas
• Olive oil, lemon, parsley

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Sauté chicken in olive oil until golden. Remove.
2. Sauté onion, garlic. Add tomatoes, paprika.
3. Add rice, stir to coat. Add saffron-infused broth.
4. Arrange chicken and seafood on top. Cook without stirring 18 min.
5. Top with peas. Cook 2 more min. Remove from heat.
6. Cover with towel. Rest 5 min. Garnish with parsley and lemon.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 15 min | Cook: 30 min | 🍴 Servings: 4-6

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1.5 lbs ground lamb or beef
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 carrots, diced
• 1 cup frozen peas
• 2 tbsp tomato paste
• 1 cup beef broth
• 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
• 2 tsp thyme
• 4 potatoes, boiled and mashed
• 1/4 cup butter
• 1/4 cup milk
• Salt, pepper

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Brown meat. Remove.
2. Sauté onion, carrots. Add tomato paste, broth, Worcestershire, thyme. Simmer 10 min.
3. Add peas and meat. Transfer to baking dish.
4. Mash potatoes with butter, milk, salt, pepper.
5. Spread mash over meat filling. Fork marks on top.
6. Bake at 400°F 25 min until golden and bubbly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 40 min | 🍴 Servings: 6

recipes.name: Ceviche
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 1 lb fresh white fish, cubed
• 1/2 cup lime juice
• 1 red onion, thinly sliced
• 1 jalapeno, minced
• 1/2 cup cilantro, chopped
• 1 sweet potato
• 1 ear corn
• Salt

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Marinate fish in lime juice 15-20 min until opaque (cooked by acid).
2. Rinse onion in cold water.
3. Drain excess lime juice from fish.
4. Toss fish with onion, jalapeno, cilantro, salt.
5. Boil sweet potato and corn until tender. Slice.
6. Serve ceviche with sweet potato and corn.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 20 min | Cook: 15 min (marinate) | 🍴 Servings: 4

recipes.name: Chili Con Carne
recipes.content:
🛒 INGREDIENTS:
• 2 lbs ground beef
• 1 onion, diced
• 4 garlic cloves
• 2 cans diced tomatoes
• 2 cans kidney beans
• 2 tbsp chili powder
• 1 tsp cumin
• 1 tsp paprika
• 1/2 tsp cayenne
• 1 cup beef broth
• Salt, pepper
• Toppings: cheese, sour cream, jalapenos

👨‍🍳 INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Brown beef in a pot. Remove.
2. Sauté onion, garlic. Add spices. Cook 2 min.
3. Add tomatoes, broth, beef. Simmer 30 min.
4. Add beans. Simmer 15 more min.
5. Season with salt and pepper.
6. Serve with toppings: cheese, sour cream, jalapenos. Best with cornbread.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ Prep: 10 min | Cook: 50 min | 🍴 Servings: 6-8
